Watch Infrayard deploy an OKE cluster

A three-minute product walkthrough: choose a template, review estimated costs and follow provisioning in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

Recorded product walkthrough · 2 min 59 sec · Instrumental music, no narration. Provisioning footage is accelerated; actual deployment time depends on your environment.Music: Dream Culture — Kevin MacLeod · CC BY 4.0. Trimmed, volume adjusted and faded.

What the walkthrough shows

  1. Choose a cluster configuration. Start from an approved template and review the settings available to the engineer.
  2. Review the estimate. Check the expected OCI resource cost before starting provisioning. Oracle bills cloud usage separately.
  3. Follow the deployment. See the provisioning workflow and Terraform execution logs in the portal.

Infrayard is a self-service layer for Oracle Kubernetes Engine. Platform teams manage templates, roles and limits; engineers use the portal for supported cluster workflows inside the customer's OCI tenancy.
